Low backdrop variety: the lower half is flat uniform sand (glass blog cards over it would blur nothing, DESIGN-SPEC 4.6 / R-11) and the requested pale aqua is absent. Content itself is compliant. Regenerate with foam and water across the frame.

Attempt 2 repeats attempt 1's layout: the lower 40% is flat uniform sand, so glass blog cards placed there would have no backdrop variety (DESIGN-SPEC 4.6 / R-11); retry with foam and water across the frame.

At full resolution the aqua pieces read as soft mint gummy candies beside the cannabis, not chalky sea glass (COMPLIANCE 2: candy look; edibles confusion), and the buds look crumbly; retry with chalky broken sea glass and frosty buds.

Attempt 2: the buds are right now, but the 'sea glass chips' render as soft opaque white pieces (like white chocolate or candy) beside the cannabis: an edibles/candy reading on a flower card (COMPLIANCE 2). Retry with grey beach pebbles.

Subject wrong and food-like: the three objects are waffle/wafer cones (read as ice-cream cones), not pre-rolls; a food/candy look fails COMPLIANCE 2 (candy look) and misstates the card. Regenerate with joints described explicitly.
Attempt 2: the three items are straight white cylinders with orange filter ends that read as cigarettes, not cannabis pre-rolls (misleading subject); retry with cone-shaped pre-rolls.

Off-palette: a saturated yellow-orange backdrop, far from the brand's pale aqua, sky and sand (DESIGN-SPEC 10.1); bright flat colour field reads as a promo flyer. Device itself is plain and unmarked. Regenerate with a pale sky backdrop.
Compliant (no people, smoke, text or marks) but shows empty paper cones rather than filled pre-rolls; replaced by attempt 2. Never referenced by a slot.
Candy look: the amber concentrate renders as jelly/gummy cubes sitting in syrup (COMPLIANCE 2, candy look); the woven pebble mat behind is busy. Regenerate with a honey-like resin.

Attempt 2: glossy honey-like amber resin in a small clear dish and beside it, a plain unmarked white device; pale sea-green ground; no people, smoke, text or marks; the resin is an amorphous blob, not cubes, shapes or gummies, so no candy look.
Text and brand-like marks: a paper card printed with pseudo-text and a printed neck tag on the hoodie (COMPLIANCE 2: no text, labels or marks).
Attempt 2: the sweatshirt's neck label carries a printed mark and tiny text (COMPLIANCE 2: no text, labels or marks).
